LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RoleComponentSnapsh: Copied into this Role when you last clicked Create/Update - not a live link. Editing this item now won't reach colonists already using this Role until you click Create/Update here again.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RoleMainWeaponTip: This part supplies the role's main weapon: {0}. Every other weapon in this role counts as a sidearm - a role may bundle a main weapon, a knife and grenades all at once.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DeletePackConfirm: Delete the equipment pack "{0}"? Colonists currently carrying it will lose these items.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DragPackTip: Drag onto a role to scale it. Edit its contents in the Equipment Packs tab.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_NoPacksYet: No Equipment Packs yet - create some in the Equipment Packs tab first.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_NewRoleTip: Adds a role stored only in THIS save. Global roles live in Mod Settings > Roles.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RoleAssignedNoneTip: No colonist is on this role right now. Hand it out in the Equip Colonists tab.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_ResetRolesConfirm: Reset all global roles to the built-in presets? (Save-local roles are kept.) A role whose name is not among the presets loses its loadout as well - colonists using it go back to no loadout, keeping their own ammo, packs and sidearms.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_ResetRolesTip: Reset the global roles to the built-in presets.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_LocalTagTip: Save-local role: exists only in this colony. To make a role that carries across all games, add it under Mod Settings > Roles.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_GlobalTagTip: Global role: available in every colony. Manage it under Mod Settings > Roles.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DeleteRoleConfirm: Delete the role "{0}" and the loadout behind it? Colonists using it go back to no loadout - their own ammo, packs and sidearms stay with them. Leaving the loadout behind would let it keep showing up as an assignable template.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DuplicateRoleTip: Duplicate this role (name, factors, and its current composition).
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_BadgeCreatedTip: This role is saved - every change on the card is written to it right away.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_BadgeNewTip: Empty - drag a weapon or pack onto it.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_FactorLockedTip: Locked: this role has nothing on it yet, so there is nothing to scale. Drag a weapon or pack onto the card first.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_AmmoFactorTip: Ammo factor (Am): multiplies the ammo count of every weapon in this role. 1 = the count from the mod settings, 0.75 = three quarters of it, 2 = double, 0 = no ammo.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_MedicineFactorTip: Medicine factor (Me): multiplies the medicine count from the role's building blocks. 1 = unchanged, 3 = three times as much, 0 = none.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_FoodFactorTip: Food factor (Fo): multiplies the food count from the role's building blocks. 1 = unchanged, 1.5 = half again as much, 0 = none.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_GrenadeFactorTip: Grenade factor (Gr): multiplies the count of grenades and thrown explosives from the role's building blocks. 1 = unchanged, 3 = three times as much, 0 = no grenades.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DragLoadoutHerePlac: drag a weapon or pack here
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_CreatedRoleContentH: contains {0} - drag a weapon or pack here to re-compose
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_CreatedRoleContentT: This Role was created before its build-up was recorded, so the blocks it was made from are unknown - only the finished contents are. Colonists on it are equipped correctly; the preview below lists everything it holds. Drag a weapon or pack here to compose it anew, which replaces the current contents.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DragLoadoutHereTip: Drag a weapon or an Equipment Pack onto this row to build the Role. It is saved automatically as soon as something is on it.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_SelectRolePrompt: Select a role and drop a weapon or pack on it to preview the result.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DropToSeeResult: Drop a weapon or pack onto this role to see the result.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RoleNameCollision: Another role is already named "{0}" - pick a different name, or that role's own loadout would be overwritten.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RoleWouldEmpty: Not saved: this would leave the role "{0}" completely empty, and every colonist on it would end up with nothing. Add its contents back first (drag a weapon or a pack onto it).
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RemoveLastChipBlock: The role's only content - it cannot be taken away. "{0}" would be left with nothing at all, and every colonist on this role would end up empty-handed. To swap it: drag the replacement onto the card first, then remove this one. To get rid of the role itself, use the x at the top right of the card.

A role loadout named "{0}" already exists from an earlier, deleted role, and {1} colonist(s) are still wearing it. Creating this role will take that loadout over and re-equip all of them at once.
Continue?
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_ResultStacksWithPac: Result: {0} stacks ({1} of them from attached packs)
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_RestorePresetsTip: Bring back the built-in roles you deleted, each in its original place. Only the missing ones are added - your own roles, their factors and their contents are untouched.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateLoadouts_DeleteRoleConfirmPr: Delete the built-in role "{0}" and the loadout behind it? Colonists using it go back to no loadout - their own ammo, packs and sidearms stay with them. This removes it from the global library for every colony; "Restore presets" brings it back empty without touching your other roles.
